title: 第1752章 卢安第1751章 集结
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：轩玄大帝正文第1752章卢安（..la）“他简直就是杀神，我们战胜不了，快逃！”
“朝四方逃，他—辆战车没办法拦住我们！”
面对着无法匹敌的玉龙战车，无数魔族强者奔逃，场面震撼，整个人魔战场都乱了，人人自危。
这一刻，他们丧失了一切斗志。
“杀！”
这场杀戮持续了一天一夜，不知道死了多少魔族强者。
这一天，血腥味在人魔战场缭绕，经日不散，玉龙战车之威，让所有人骇然。
“***，这十多天，杀我们的人杀爽了，现在也尝到被虐杀的滋味了吧！”
“终于报了这十多天的仇，现在我们杀的，比起这十多天来，他们杀我们的人多了好几倍吧！”
“杀光了才好！”
人族强者杀声震天，气势如虹。
人魔战场，从来不会存在任何的怜悯，也不会存在投降，只有赤裸裸的杀戮，无情的杀戮，这是战场生存法则。
此刻，人族强者才品尝到了这种摧枯拉朽式的一面倒杀戮，每一个人都像是打了鸡血一般的凶猛，战场绞肉机疯狂的转动着，无数生命在流逝。
而唯一能够阻止这场杀戮的，只有巴奥，他只要将终极战旗升起，战争就会停止。
毕竟，人魔战场太过浩瀚，就算是集结，一天一夜的时间，也是远远的不够。
“呵呵，可真能忍的！”
现在，战争已经演变成屠杀，虚空中，那黑袍指挥目光投向战场，嘴中，传出淡漠的声音。
“巴奥，他既怀有仇恨，也抱着幻想，是不会轻易启动终极战场的，他这种人，又怎么可能会顾及族人生死。”
那石总指挥嘴角微弯，道。
“仇恨，幻想？”

黑袍指挥微微一怔。
“龙魔刀，是他弟弟的，现在在那辆战车中，而那小子之所以能够发挥出这么惊人的实力，也完全是靠那辆战车。”
石总指挥淡淡的一笑，道：“这种大杀器，他又怎么可能会放弃，一旦得到，就连高端战场的格局也能改变。”
“而高端战场，才是整个战场的决胜关键，人命对于他这种人来说，又算是什么？”
黑袍指挥点了点头，旋即不再说话，对于这一幕，他同样是已经麻木。
如果这一次，没有玉龙战车这支异军突起，那么，这种迹象，就会发生在人族这边。
那巴奥，连自己族人的生死都不顾，又怎么可能会在意人族的生死。
“巴奥大人，不如我们还是开启终极模式吧，否则，一旦族人伤亡过大，我们也不好交差！”
而魔族这边，那蓝服指挥尚算冷静，他望着巴奥，抱了抱拳，道。
“不，卢安马上赶到了，只要他们赶到，整个战场便能掌控。”
巴奥冲着那蓝服指挥一笑，笑容却是瞬间狰狞：“那小子，固然要挫骨扬灰，而更重要的是，那辆战车，就连是拼光了人，也一定要得到！”
尽管巴奥的声音，充满了一种无法洗刷的虐杀，但此刻，他更看重的是玉龙战车。
虽然他不敢完全断定肖恩仅仅只是星台境，但也敢说高不到哪里去，一旦在他手中，这里，便不再是他的舞台。
一将功成万骨枯，魔族本来就奉行这种信条。
现在，想要他改变主意，恐怕只有真正能够决定他生死之人到来才行。
轰隆隆！
庞大的人魔战场上，遥远的天际，终于是波荡起阵阵惊人的威压，两股洪流汇聚而来。
此刻，人魔两方强者，也终于是集结到位！
那惊天的威压蔓延而来，肖恩也是停下了追赶，挥手止住队形，静待双方强者回归阵营。
最少，他必须要评估双方实力，才能够决定战斗方式。

中端战场真正的战斗，现在才算开始。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1752 of the main text of Emperor Xuanxuan Lu An (..la) "He is simply a god of death. We can't defeat him, so run away!"
"Fleeing in all directions, his chariot can't stop us!"
Facing the unmatched Jade Dragon Chariot, countless strong demons fled. The scene was shocking. The entire battlefield between humans and demons was in chaos, and everyone was in danger.
At this moment, they lost all fighting spirit.
"Kill!"
The killing lasted for a day and a night, and countless powerful demons died.
On this day, the smell of blood lingered in the battlefield between humans and demons, and it persisted through the day. The power of the Jade Dragon Chariot shocked everyone.
"***, in the past ten days or so, those who killed us have had a great time killing us. Now they have tasted the feeling of being tortured and killed!"
"Finally we have taken revenge for more than ten days. Now we have killed several times more people than they have killed us in these ten days!"
"Just kill them all!"
The strong men of the human race made killing sounds that shook the sky, and their momentum was like a rainbow.
In the battlefield between humans and demons, there will never be any mercy or surrender, only naked killing and ruthless killing. This is the law of survival on the battlefield.
At this moment, the strong humans experienced this devastating one-sided killing. Everyone was as ferocious as chicken blood. The meat grinder on the battlefield was turning crazily, and countless lives were passing by.
The only one who can stop this killing is Bao. As long as he raises the ultimate battle flag, the war will stop.
After all, the battlefield between humans and demons is so vast that even if they gather together, one day and one night will not be enough.
"Haha, you can really bear it!"
Now, the war has turned into a massacre. In the void, the black-robed commander cast his eyes on the battlefield, and an indifferent voice came from his mouth.
"Bao, he has both hatred and illusions. He will not easily start the ultimate battlefield. How can a person like him care about the life and death of his people."
Commander Shi's mouth slightly curved and he said.
"Hate, fantasy?"
The black-robed commander was slightly startled.
"The Dragon Demon Sword belongs to his younger brother, and is now in that chariot. The reason why that boy is able to exert such amazing strength is entirely due to that chariot."
Commander Shi smiled faintly and said: "How could he give up such a powerful weapon? Once he gets it, even the pattern of high-end battlefields can be changed."
"And the high-end battlefield is the key to victory on the entire battlefield. What does human life mean to a person like him?"
The black-robed commander nodded and immediately stopped talking. He was also numb to this scene.
If there is no sudden rise of the Jade Dragon Chariot this time, then this sign will happen on the human side.
Nabao didn't even care about the life and death of his own people, how could he care about the life and death of the human race.
"Lord Bao, why don't we turn on the ultimate mode? Otherwise, once the casualties among the tribe are too large, it will be difficult for us to communicate!"
On the demon side, the blue-suited commander was relatively calm. He looked at Bao, clasped his fists, and said.
"No, Lu An will arrive soon. As long as they arrive, the entire battlefield will be under their control."
Bao smiled at the blue-suited commander, but his smile turned ferocious in an instant: "That boy will certainly be crushed to death, but more importantly, he must get that chariot, even if all the people are killed!"
Although Bao's voice was full of a kind of cruelty that could not be washed away, at this moment, what he valued more was the Jade Dragon Chariot.
Although he dare not completely conclude that Sean is only in the Star Stage realm, he can also say that it is not much higher. Once in his hands, this place will no longer be his stage.
The demon clan has always adhered to this creed.
Now, if he wants to change his mind, I am afraid that only the arrival of someone who can really decide his life and death will do the trick.
Boom!
On the huge human-demonic battlefield, in the distant sky, waves of astonishing pressure finally surged, and two torrentsCome together.
At this moment, the powerful men and women from the human and demon sides have finally gathered in place!
The shocking pressure spread, and Sean stopped chasing, waved his hand to stop the formation, and waited for the strong men from both sides to return to the camp.
At the very least, he must evaluate the strength of both sides before he can decide how to fight.
The real battle on the mid-range battlefield has only begun now.
